content.text:
This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built nothing and ran no solve.

The case needs two WaterTAP `Crystallization` units (C1 and C2). Each has a feed inlet and separate solids, vapor and mother-liquor outlets. Each also takes a specified operating temperature and a NaCl crystallization yield. The units sit on the WaterTAP NaCl crystallization property package, which has liquid, vapor and solid phases and a constant heat of crystallization.

`list_models` offers only these model families:
- **Plain units:** mixers, splitters, heaters, pumps, valves, feed sources and product sinks.
- **Flash and reactor units:** TP and PH flashes, a conversion reactor, a kinetic CSTR and a heat exchanger.
- **Component separator:** a generic separator with a top and a bottom outlet.

None of these are a crystallizer:
- **Ports:** nothing has a solids outlet.
- **Specifications:** no model can take a crystallization yield as a specification.
- **Solid phase:** no model carries one.

The listed flash and separator models don't do what the case's units do. They have no solid phase, so substituting one would not be a faithful representation. I did not check whether NaCl exists as a component, since the missing unit and property package already rule the case out.

None is a WaterTAP Crystallization unit with solids, vapor and mother-liquor outlets, an operating-temperature specification and a crystallization-yield specification. There is also no NaCl crystallization property package with a solid (crystal) phase and a constant heat of crystallization. A flash or separator would not represent the units, so no substitute was built and no solve was run."}, "claims": []}
